
# Workspace Skills

This folder contains project-specific Copilot skills for cpp-ai-chat-server.

## Included Skills

- cpp-cmake-test-fix: Build and test failure diagnosis for C++/CMake/GoogleTest.
- database-query-optimizer: SQLite query and index optimization workflow.
- frontend-message-system: React chat message pipeline and UI behavior stabilization.
- docker-production-hardening: Production-focused Docker and compose hardening.
- feature-learning-log: Record structured post-feature learning logs into docs/devlog.md.

## Usage

Ask Copilot with intent matching each skill description, for example:

- "Fix this CMake test failure"
- "Optimize message history query performance"
- "Implement frontend message render and reconnect handling"
- "Harden docker-compose for production"
- "Feature done, write a learning log entry"
